messages.text:
BL-1438 — BL-1432's ruled re-point of the QA branch shipped with no live caller: post-land-repoint! is built and tested in land_step_lib.bb and nothing invokes it, so the QA branch keeps growing by a few commits per land and BL-1432's live check cannot be run; land_main_publish.sh, the script QA runs for every land, invokes it once a land has published, prints the outcome, and never lets a skipped re-point fail the land
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-05 by the specifier on QA's priority-00 note (verbatim in
description) after BL-1432 landed. The miss is the specifier's own:
BL-1432 was a two-mechanism ticket and its required_wiring named only
the handler; the first rule under "Required wiring declarations" in the
specifier's prom…
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. This wires the re-point you ruled under BL-1432 option 3 into the publish script; the mechanism exists and passed its gates, it simp…
BL-1438 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1438" (or "reject BL-1438 <reason>") to act.
